Description: The CTI payload, stored verbatim. Only some of its fields are indexed.
The CTI offset the document was delivered at.
The type of the CTI content, for example a CVE record or one of the global maps the vulnerability scanner requires.
The containers of the CVE record.
The container of the CVE Numbering Authority.
The CNA metrics, one object per CVSS version.
The metadata of the CVE record.
The short name of the organization that assigned the CVE.
Date the record was last updated.
The publication state of the record.
